1. List revised.

4. This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicant(s) Matloob Ahmad and Haseena with the prayer to quash the entire criminal proceeding of complaint case No. 3301 of 2014 (Smt. Danish Jahan Vs. Matloob Ahmad and others) under Sections 498A IPC as well as summoning order dated 03.10.2014 issued by Judicial Magistrate, J.P. Nagar in the aforesaid case and with a further prayer to stay the further proceedings of the aforesaid case, during the pendency Matloob Ahmad And Another vs State Of U.P. 1 of the present application.

sentences.text: 5. The matter is of the year 2014.

6. The present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is dismissed as infructuous.
